instructions_to_main_agent: Use the 'Oswald' font for all headings to give a strong, industrial feel.
Use 'Manrope' for body text for maximum legibility.
Implement a 'Dark Mode' aesthetic by default using the slate-950 background.
Use the provided Unsplash images for the Hero and About sections.
For the Partner Showcase, create a text-based marquee if logos are not available, using bold, uppercase company names in a muted slate color.
Ensure the 'Apply Now' button is always visible or easily accessible (sticky header or floating action button on mobile).
The form should be simple and high-contrast. Use white text on dark input fields.
Display the phone number (479) 977-6813 prominently in the header and footer.
